description: This file contains unit tests for the TimePurgePredicate class, which determines whether messages should be purged from a cache based on time-related thresholds. It defines multiple test methods using the Xunit framework to verify the behavior under different cache age scenarios.

classes.name: TimePurgePredicateTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the TimePurgePredicate class, focusing on cache purge thresholds based on message age and time in cache.

methods.name: TimePurgePredicate_NoPurgeThreshold_Tests
methods.description: Tests that messages not meeting the purge thresholds are not purged.

methods.name: TimePurgePredicate_PurgeDataThreshold_Tests
methods.description: Tests that messages meeting the purge thresholds are marked for purging.

methods.name: TimePurgePredicate_NoPurgeAgeThreshold_Tests
methods.description: Verifies that messages not old enough in age are not purged even if they have been in cache long enough.

methods.name: TimePurgePredicate_NoPurgeTimeInCacheThreshold_Tests
methods.description: Checks that messages not in cache long enough are not purged, regardless of their age.
